issues.detail: The Greek text states 'αρνουμενων δε παντων' (but all [of them] were denying), which indicates that everyone was denying Him. The Vietnamese translation 'Mọi người đều chối' (Everyone denied) captures the action but misses the specific grammatical connection of 'δε' (but/however) which contrasts the denial with the preceding context of the arrest.

The Greek 'επιστατα οι οχλοι' is more accurately 'the crowds were pressing/crowding' (active). The Vietnamese 'đám đông đang vây lấy và ép Thầy' adds 'vây lấy' (surrounding), which is a common interpretation but not explicitly in the verb 'επιστατα'.
